explanation: This row has more `&`-separated entries than the environment's column specification allows, so TeX gave up on the row early rather than guess where it should have ended. Count the `&`s in this row against the `{...}` column spec (or `\begin{tabular}`'s own argument), and check the row above it for a missing `\\` that would make two rows read as one.
rawMessage: Extra alignment tab has been changed to \cr.
title: More columns than this row declared
